rule: Reject the session as 'no_exercise_detected' (skip the classifier entirely) if EVERY gate feature's observed value is below its threshold. Using AND across multiple independent motion signals means a session is only rejected when there is really no sign of curling motion in any of them -- the moment any one signal shows real movement, the classifier runs as normal. Thresholds are set at 50% of the weakest real repetition ever recorded in the dataset, so genuine (even very poor-form) reps are not falsely rejected.
